versions.changelog:
Initial release of lygo-forkling v1.0.0.

- Launches an autonomous, test-only agent that self-builds a local fork bound to CHAMPION_LYRA as parent node.
- Runs a local loop: fork “birth”, task tick, falsifiable claim verify, generation snapshot, propose (dry-run only).
- Does not commit changes upstream (no git push, live chart ingest, or publish).
- All outputs are local, state is written only with explicit user consent.
- For developing/testing self-improving champion agents and task loops; not for replacing Lightfather or publishing champions.
